messages:
Aisha K.: Quick check-in for private/VPC customers — weekly health + onboarding notes. Heads-up: 3 region anomalies (eu-west, ap-south, us-central), two accounts on renewal watch (Horizon SaaS, Meridian Analytics).

Tom L.: Can you call out exact windows and which customers were impacted?

Aisha K.: eu-west: NovaCorp saw KMS latency spikes 02:05–03:40 UTC during nightly bulk reads. ap-south: brief connectivity flaps impacting cert handshake for Lumenix at ~11:10 IST. us-central: small p95 CPU bump on dedicated nodes for EmberCo during batch window; not cause for immediate action.

Luis M.: Provider metrics for eu-west: median KMS = 115ms, p95 = 390ms, outliers to ~760ms. No HSM rotations failed. Networking provider reports scheduled maintenance with slipped drain in one AZ. I'm requesting BGP + maintenance timeline.

infra-bot: ```region: eu-west
kms_latency_ms: [115, 130, 390, 760]
uptime_pct: 99.62
errors_pct: 0.38
```

Jin P.: For NovaCorp, recommend short-term client-side mitigations: enable local KMS caching, reduce batch window concurrency, and set retry backoff lower bounds. Snippet for their SDK:```yaml
kms_cache: true
cache_ttl_s: 60
max_concurrency: 4
retry: { initial_ms: 40, max_ms: 400 }
```

Marta S.: Noted on onboarding: NovaCorp still needs the SDK update pushed to their staging. I've scheduled a 30m enablement call for Thurs 10am PT.

Aisha K.: Renewal watch details: Horizon SaaS — usage down 42% q/q, tail token latency creeping up to 420ms p95; propose outreach + targeted workshop + 1mo credit. Meridian Analytics — spend unpredictable; heavy nightly ingestion spikes causing cost overruns; CS to confirm whether expected.

Tom L.: I'll open ticket with the network provider for eu-west and request a postmortem. Assigning to Luis for follow-up.

Luis M.: Taking it. Will request logs and postmortem; ETA 36h.

Jin P.: I'll draft the enablement note and CLI commands for NovaCorp today and share runbook for CS.

Aisha K.: Action list (short):
- Luis M.: provider postmortem + metrics export (36h)
- Tom L.: infra escalation (done)
- Jin P.: enablement note + runbook (EOD)
- Marta S./CS: schedule Horizon renewal outreach + usage review (by EOW)
- Finance/CS: confirm EmberCo nightly job intent and consider temporary quota cap if unconfirmed

Marta S.: Will prepare renewal play and invite product to the Horizon call.

Aisha K.: Thanks — I'll push this into the weekly digest and the renewal watch spreadsheet. :white_check_mark:
